text: The one breaking change this week is #14002: External File Storage now rejects any path segment that is "." or "..", so callers passing relative segments get an error. Other behaviour changes are mostly fixes. Copilot work moves on: #14059 switches No. Series Copilot to GPT-5.6 Ceres, #14198 updates Sales Lines Suggestions prompts for the same migration, and #14007 discontinues Create Product Information with Copilot, with #14218 limiting the related notification to super users in affected companies. Localization fixes cover Italy (#14124, #11660), Norway (#13820, plus SAF-T 1.40 support in #13264), the Czech Republic (#13868, #13631), Germany (#13807, #14018) and India GST (#13243). Core finance and supply fixes include #13917 on credit memo unit of measure, #13987 on VAT number validation, #14020 on the In-Transit Code, #11026 on service line VAT difference and #13622 on Edit in Excel for price lines. Expense Agent gets #13587, #13978 and #13920. E-documents get #14200 and #13679. Fabric mirroring gets #13558 and #14146. #13999 speeds up Intrastat XML export. #9326 moves Finnish Depreciation Differences into a first-party extension, with legacy code obsolete and removal planned for version 33.

issues: It leaves out some behaviour changes that readers may care about. The most notable is #14203: Business Central online now always uses commercial Dataverse endpoints, whatever cloud is selected, while on-premises still follows the setting. Also left out: #14078 (PEPPOL30 credit memo schema fix), #14006 (duplicate handling in the Dynamics GP migration), #13717 (electronic payments export no longer clears another vendor's Document No.), #14219, #14122, #13757, #13601 and #12664. These are omissions, not errors.
#9326 sits in the middle of behaviour-change items, but it is flagged as a refactor with no behaviour change. It doesn't claim to be one, so the wording is acceptable.
